model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates an effect, visualized through the heights of the bars, categorized by different IE family groups (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indig, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) and various models (XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2). The vertical axis represents the effect, likely a measure of some quantitative impact or result, with a scale that reaches up to 30, as the highest point on a bar exceeds this value slightly. The horizontal axis lists the IE families, serving as categories for comparative analysis within the chart. Each group's effect is shown using a combination of bars in different colors, corresponding to a model: XLM-L2 in blue, mBERT-R2 in green, XLM-R2 in red, mBERT-B2 in light blue, and XLM-B2 in pink. The chart includes mean values indicated by the central lines within the bars, and error bars that suggest variability or uncertainty in the measurements, extending both upwards and downwards from the mean values. The tallest bars represent the highest observed effects, and notably, there is significant variability within each group as indicated by the length of the error bars. No explicit visual emphasis on any bars suggests a uniform treatment of all values, and no bars are sorted in a specific order or highlighted in any way that would indicate a ranking or priority among the groups or models.
